characters.name: Gjertrud
characters.description: Gjertrud is a woman of average height, with a sturdy build typical of someone accustomed to manual labor. She wears a distinctive red hat, her notable feature, which sits atop her dark, slightly untidy hair. Her facial features suggest a common, rustic beauty with a stern undertone, fitting her role as a homemaker. In her kitchen setting, she is seen baking with a plain, utilitarian dress suitable for working around a hearth. Her expressions range from determined concentration to surprise and frustration as her attempts to make small lefse consistently lead to oversized results.

characters.name: Gjertrudsfuglen
characters.description: Gjertrudsfuglen, once the woman Gjertrud, is now a bird transformed by divine punishment. She has a striking red crest reminiscent of the red hat she wore as a human. The rest of her plumage is entirely soot-black, symbolizing her passage through the chimney. As a bird, she continuously pecks at trees for sustenance, an eternal reminder of her frugality. Her appearance is marked by an ever-present longing in her eyes, aligned with her perpetual thirst, as she reacts to the anticipation of rain with visible eagerness.
